name: The morning game drive
when: From first light, through the morning. Afternoon and full-day drives also run
live: The vehicle stops at the edge of the plains and the engine goes quiet. Elephants cross ahead, close enough to hear the grass tear.
good_to_know: Bring a warm layer for the early start and a camera with a long lens.
alt: Elephants grazing beside a safari vehicle on the open plains
